"""Dense sum-based predicates at brute-forceable scale, verified against both references."""
import ctypes, json, random, sys
ctypes.CDLL('/workspace/vendor/system-libs/libz.so.1', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/vendor'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/dev')
from brute import brute_job
from ref2 import ref2_job
from netnomos.nppipeline import compile_job as np_job
from netnomos.pypipeline import compile_job as py_job

bad = 0
for seed in range(60):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    F = rng.randint(4, 7)
    fields = [{'name':f'f{i}','type':['time','size','count','id','flag'][i%5],
               'domain': sorted(rng.sample(range(4), rng.randint(2,3)))} for i in range(F)]
    U = 1
    for f in fields: U *= len(f['domain'])
    if U > 400: continue
    P = rng.randint(8, 14)
    preds = []
    for i in range(P):
        style = rng.random()
        refs = rng.sample([[0, f['name']] for f in fields], rng.randint(1, min(4, F)))
        if style < 0.6:
            tot = sum(rng.choice(next(f['domain'] for f in fields if f['name']==r[1])) for r in refs)
            preds.append({'kind':'cmp','left':{'sum':refs},'op':rng.choice(['ge','le','gt','lt','eq','ne']),
                          'right':{'const':max(0,tot+rng.choice([-1,0,1])),'type':'count'}})
        elif style < 0.8:
            f = rng.choice(fields)
            preds.append({'kind':rng.choice(['any','all']),'field':f['name'],
                          'op':rng.choice(['eq','ne','ge','le','gt','lt']),
                          'value':rng.choice(f['domain'])})
        else:
            f = rng.choice(fields)
            preds.append({'kind':'cmp','left':{'scale':rng.choice([0,1,2,3]),'ref':[0,f['name']]},
                          'op':'ge','right':{'const':rng.choice(f['domain'])*2,'type':f['type']}})
    train = [[[rng.choice(f['domain']) for f in fields]] for _ in range(rng.randint(3, 12))]
    pre = brute_job({'fields':fields,'slots':1,'predicates':preds,'width':4,'train':train,'approved':[],'queries':[]})
    disc = [r['clause'] for r in pre['rules']]
    approved = [c for c in disc if rng.random()<0.7] or (disc[:1] if disc else [])
    queries = [{'target':[0,rng.choice([f['name'] for f in fields])],
                'prefix':rng.choice(['','0','1','2','01','10']),
                'fixed':[{'ref':[0,f['name']],'value':rng.choice(f['domain'])} for f in rng.sample(fields, rng.randint(0,1))]}
               for _ in range(6)]
    queries = [q for q in queries if all(b['ref'][1] != [f['name'] for f in fields][ [f['name'] for f in fields].index(q['target'][1])] for b in q['fixed'])]
    job = {'fields':fields,'slots':1,'predicates':preds,'width':4,'train':train,'approved':approved,'queries':queries}
    want = brute_job(job); want2 = ref2_job(job)
    a = np_job(job); b = py_job(job)
    if not (a == want == want2 == b):
        bad += 1
        print('MISMATCH seed', seed, 'rules', len(want['rules']))
        print(json.dumps(job)[:2000]); print('np ', json.dumps(a)[:800]); print('ref', json.dumps(want)[:800])
        break
    if seed % 20 == 0:
        print('seed', seed, 'U=%d P=%d rules=%d active=%d' % (U, P, len(want['rules']), len(want['active'])))
print('dense-sum differential failures:', bad)
PYEOF
